AT.name: Austria
AT.fact: In Austria you can see mountains almost everywhere – the Alps cover more than half of the country.

BE.name: Belgium
BE.fact: Belgium has over 1,000 kinds of chocolate – and its famous fries come from here, too!

HR.name: Croatia
HR.fact: Croatia has more than 1,000 islands in the blue Mediterranean Sea.

CZ.name: Czechia
CZ.fact: Prague Castle in Czechia is one of the biggest castles in the whole world.

DK.name: Denmark
DK.fact: LEGO bricks were invented in Denmark!

FI.name: Finland
FI.fact: Finland is the land of saunas: there are more saunas than cars.

FR.name: France
FR.fact: The Eiffel Tower in France is as tall as 100 giraffes stacked on top of each other!

DE.name: Germany
DE.fact: More than 83 million people live in Germany – more than in any other country in the EU.

GR.name: Greece
GR.fact: The Olympic Games were invented in Greece almost 3,000 years ago.

HU.name: Hungary
HU.fact: Lake Balaton in Hungary is so big that people call it the 'Hungarian Sea'.

IS.name: Iceland
IS.fact: Iceland has more than 30 active volcanoes and hot springs you can bathe in.

IE.name: Ireland
IE.fact: Ireland is called the 'Emerald Isle' because lush green meadows grow almost everywhere.

IT.name: Italy
IT.fact: On the map, Italy looks like a boot – and pizza was invented here.

NL.name: the Netherlands
NL.fact: The Netherlands is so flat that a large part of the country lies below sea level.

NO.name: Norway
NO.fact: Norway has so many fjords and islands that its coastline is incredibly long – over 100,000 kilometres!

PL.name: Poland
PL.fact: Wild bison – the biggest land animals in Europe – still live in Poland.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.fact: Portugal lies at the far west of Europe – famous explorers once set sail from here.

RO.name: Romania
RO.fact: Count Dracula's castle stands in Romania – right in the Carpathian Mountains.

ES.name: Spain
ES.fact: Once a year, Spain has a giant tomato fight – thousands of people throw tomatoes at each other!

SE.name: Sweden
SE.fact: Sweden has almost 100,000 lakes – counting them would take you days!

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.fact: Switzerland has more than 40 mountains higher than 4,000 metres.

TR.name: Turkey
TR.fact: Turkey lies on two continents at the same time: Europe and Asia.

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.fact: Ukraine is the biggest country that lies entirely in Europe.

GB.name: the United Kingdom
GB.fact: In the United Kingdom, cars drive on the left side of the road.
